issues.issue: Text claims committee was 'planned or convened' but the quote only supports 'No Advisory Committee is planned', slightly overstating the citation.
Automated flag on '30' is a false positive: 30 mg/kg is a dose (excluded category) and is supported by the n-field citation 'AMONDYS 45 30 mg/kg Once Weekly'.
Automated flag on '45' is a false positive: it refers to 'exon 45 skipping', which appears in the result citation, not an uncited efficacy figure.
Automated flags on '2020' and '2' are false positives: they are date components and a submission ordinal, both non-efficacy/safety and supported by the '1/10/20; 6/25/20' citation.
Automated flags on '4045' and '301' are false positives: they are the study identifier (Study 4045-301), an excluded category.
